name: Hotel Grande Bretagne
positioning: Historic grand hotel on Syntagma Square in central Athens, open since 1874 (officially Hotel Grande Bretagne, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Athens)
best_for: Travelers who want a central Athens base on Syntagma Square with Acropolis views
Guests drawn to a hotel with a long history and rooms furnished with antiques and original art

facts.text: The hotel is on Syntagma Square in central Athens, overlooking the Hellenic Parliament and the National Garden.
The hotel is within walking distance of Monastiraki flea market, museums and the business district.
The hotel has stood in the heart of Athens since 1874.
When the Olympic Games were revived in 1896, the hotel was the official host of foreign missions, diplomats, statesmen and royalty.
Sir Winston Churchill was a frequent guest, and a meeting room in the hotel bears his name.
In-house guests can take a museum tour of the hotel's history, antiques and art masterpieces on request.
Rooms and suites combine sumptuous fabrics, original artworks, museum-quality antiques and classic architectural features with modern technology.
Floor-to-ceiling windows give views across Acropolis Hill and Syntagma Square.
Suite guests receive personalized 24-hour Butler Service and expedited check-in.
The Winter Garden is known for its afternoon tea.
An 18th-century tapestry of Alexander the Great is the focal point of Alexander's Bar.
The concierge team are Clefs d'Or members who arrange tours, dinner reservations and tickets.

highlights.text: The fifth-floor Royal Suite has one bedroom and two bathrooms, with windows framing views of Syntagma Square, the Acropolis, the Parliament and Lycabettus Hill.
The GB Roof Garden rooftop restaurant serves Mediterranean dining with views of the Acropolis, Lycabettus Hill and Parliament.
The outdoor pool is on the 7th floor with backdrops of Lycabettus Hill.
In 1960 Maria Callas stayed at the hotel, and the piano she used for rehearsals is in the Royal Suite.
The pool deck becomes an open-air movie theater in summer.

considerations.text: The downtown setting around the hotel has hectic energy and roaring traffic.
A smart dress code is strictly imposed for dinners at GB Roof Garden.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing at the top tier of the market.
